measurement_scope: Unique main receipts,currently loaded image observed at RAF,and stage GL submissions divided by each shared frozen window. Not compositor/physical display FPS. Age starts at JPEG encode start; all outliers retained.
gate_scope: Measured status checks channel/compile/probe/order/dimensions/variant/thread/cast and <=2s worker-stat arrival gap. It does not enforce a frame-age percentile or maximum threshold; substantial ages can validly coexist with passed continuity.
transport_mechanism: src/lib/ai/webrtc-transport.ts creates frames with default reliable ordered delivery;canSend uses a256KiB bufferedAmount threshold. A frame admitted below the threshold may bring the buffer above it. Server mailbox cannot evict a JPEG already queued in browser/SCTP. Effective mailbox admission is1inflight+1latest waiting frame; mailbox-off admits pending3.
episode_interpretation: The6.86s compute-capture512r0 delay is already present at receive. Client buffer saturation/no new sends and tens-of-ms worker processing/queue plus <=11.8ms receive→stage on the84 frames aged>1s support transport backlog before/after worker processing,not a multi-second measured inference operation. Exact network direction,packet-loss cause,IPC/host-scheduling contribution are not resolved by these timestamps. Final22ms RTT is an end snapshot,not an episode RTT.
comparison_limits: Do not mix these1GPU/Torch2.11/native128 trials with prior2GPU/Torch2.13 results or lower-thread quality-changing tests. A future40/30FPS send cap would trade throughput/freshness and is not an image-quality change; no such live trial is implied or launched here.
